reasoning: Two independent audits (deepseek-v4-flash and openrouter/free) successfully reviewed all package files and found no malicious behavior. disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen3-235b model, which failed to complete the audit of claude-desktop-extra.install due to an HTTP 400 BadRequestError. coverage_issues: qwen3-235b model failed to audit claude-desktop-extra.install due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from security-related inconclusive verdicts in the final result
When one model fails due to infrastructure issues, successful audits from other models should carry decisive weight rather than forcing an overall inconclusive verdict
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur to prevent coverage gaps
